title: Malicious Prayer
description: A specimen-plate approach to creature design: the mantis rendered in a cold lavender duotone against a faint blueprint grid, treating the subject like a field study rather than a movie tie-in. Chunky pixel-block lettering for "PREDATOR" contrasts against a vertical, hand-set 'PRAYER' running down the left margin — two words in tension, mirroring the duality in the copy beneath them (architect and predator in the same breath)..
